```yaml
name: Lint and Document

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install golangci-lint

      - name: Run linter
        id: lint
        run: golangci-lint run

      - name: Check for new lint errors
        if: ${{ steps.lint.outcome == 'failure' }}
        run: echo "New lint errors detected. Please fix them."

  document:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Create roadmap sections
        run: |
          echo "# Document Understanding Tasks" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Task | Description |" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "|------|-------------|" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Table Structure Recognition | Extract tables from documents." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Key-Value Extraction | Identify and extract key-value pairs." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Reading Order | Determine the logical reading sequence of elements." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Handwriting | Recognize handwritten text." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Scene Text | Detect and recognize text within images or scenes." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Document Classification | Categorize documents into predefined classes." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Multi-Page Context | Understand relationships between pages in a document." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Figure/Chart Awareness | Identify and process figures and charts." >> docs/roadmap.md

          echo "# Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Task | Description |" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "|------|-------------|" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Realistic Noise | Add realistic noise to datasets." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Complex Layouts | Generate datasets with complex page layouts." >> docs/roadmap.md

          echo "# Modeling Additions" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Task | Description |" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "|------|-------------|" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Quantization Recipes | Provide recipes for model quantization." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Confidence Estimation | Estimate prediction confidence levels." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Serving Example | Provide examples on how to serve models." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| ONNX/TRT Export | Support exporting models to ONNX and TensorRT formats." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Data Mixing Strategy | Develop strategies for mixing different types of data." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Experiment Tracking | Implement tools for tracking experiments." >> docs/roadmap.md

          echo "# Benchmarking Additions" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Task | Description |" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "|------|-------------|" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Robustness Benchmarks | Evaluate model robustness under various conditions." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Commercial API Comparison | Compare performance against commercial OCR APIs." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Cross-Dataset Generalization | Assess model's ability to generalize across different datasets." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| CI Regression Testing | Automate regression testing in continuous integration." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Failure Mode Taxonomy | Define categories of potential failures." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Domain-Specific Benchmarks | Create benchmarks tailored to specific domains." >> docs/roadmap.md

          echo "# Developer Experience" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Task | Description |" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "|------|-------------|" >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Unified CLI | Develop a unified command-line interface." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Tutorials | Create comprehensive tutorials for users." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Model Cards | Provide detailed information about models." >> docs/roadmap.md
          echo "| Output Format Interop | Ensure compatibility between different output formats." >> docs/roadmap.md

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git add docs/roadmap.md
          git commit -m "Add roadmap sections"
          git push origin main
```

This GitHub Actions workflow performs linting using `golangci-lint` and then creates new sections in the `docs/roadmap.md` file based on the specified tasks. The workflow is triggered on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.
